milestones.title: M0 – Foundation
milestones.description: Repo, CI/CD, ADRs, methodology, Flutter skeleton. See docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 0.

milestones.title: M1 – MVP
milestones.description: Local-first Android app: signal monitor, GPS, speed test, latency, drive-test sessions, local storage, CSV/GeoJSON export. Release v0.1.0.

milestones.title: M2 – Coverage & Drive Test
milestones.description: FastAPI + PostGIS backend, upload/sync, H3 coverage maps, drive-test replay, KML/GeoPackage. Release v0.2.0.

milestones.title: M3 – QoE & Analytics
milestones.description: Web/video/voice tests, UDP loss/jitter, QoE scoring, DuckDB analytics, dashboards. Release v0.3.0.

milestones.title: M4 – Crowdsourcing & Benchmarking
milestones.description: Identity, crowdsourcing, privacy engineering, operator rankings, regulator reports. Release v1.0.0.

milestones.title: M5 – Intelligence
milestones.description: Anomaly detection, coverage prediction, complaint correlation, automated insights.

issues.title: [M0] Configure branches and branch protection
issues.body:
Create `develop`; protect `main` and `develop` (PR required, 1 approval, status checks: Mobile CI, Backend CI, CodeQL, Security scan).

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `develop` is default branch
- [ ] Direct pushes to `main` blocked

Ref: docs/ROADMAP.md

issues.title: [M1] RadioCollector: LTE & NR serving/neighbour cells
issues.body:
Kotlin `RadioCollector` using TelephonyCallback (31+) / PhoneStateListener (29–30) and `requestCellInfoUpdate`. Map CellInfoLte/CellInfoNr per methodology §2–3 (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, RSSI, CQI, TA, PCI, TAC, ECI→eNB, NCI→gNB, EARFCN/NR-ARFCN, band).

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] UNAVAILABLE→null, out-of-range→null+quality_flag
- [ ] Mapper unit tests incl. eNB/gNB derivation
- [ ] Stale cells (>2 s) flagged

Ref: docs/ROADMAP.md

issues.title: [M1] RadioCollector: GSM & WCDMA support
issues.body:

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live screen shows 2G/3G correctly
